title: eludite/project/properties
description: The project property pages' catalog with its values (brief 0049; host-rpc.md, "Project properties"): every catalog property's evaluated and raw value in one configuration, platform and framework, the file and element that define it, and the `conditioned` and `inherited` flags. The host evaluates the project with its own in-process MSBuild (a second evaluation with `Configuration`, `Platform` and `TargetFramework` as global properties), off the request thread, and keeps the answer per generation, configuration, platform and framework, so asking again is free until an edit or a reload moves the generation.

project.description: Absolute path of a project file of the open solution (`.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`), or the project file that is open as the solution.

configuration.description: A project configuration (`Debug`, `Release`, or the project's own from its `Configurations` property). Omitted: the project configuration the active solution configuration maps it to (eludite/solution/setConfiguration's `select`), else `Debug`.

platform.description: A project platform as MSBuild names it (`AnyCPU`, `x64`, `x86`, `ARM64`). The solution's `Any CPU` is accepted and read as `AnyCPU`. Omitted: the platform the active selection maps it to, else the project's first `Platforms` entry (`AnyCPU`).

framework.description: A target framework of a multi-targeted project (`net8.0`): the evaluation sets `TargetFramework` to it, as an inner build does. Omitted: the outer evaluation (the project's `TargetFrameworks`).

generation.description: The generation the values were evaluated under; an edit must carry it.

project.description: Absolute path of the project file.

kind.description: sdk, or legacy (non-SDK: every property is read-only, with a note).

framework.description: The framework evaluated, when one was asked for.

configurations.description: The project's configurations (its `Configurations` property; `Debug`, `Release` by default), for the Configuration list.

platforms.description: The project's platforms (its `Platforms` property; `AnyCPU` by default), for the Platform list.

pages.description: The pages, in Visual Studio's order.

page.description: One property page, in Visual Studio's order.

state.description: ready: the catalog's properties of this page are listed; launchProfiles: the Debug page, the launch profiles editor (eludite/project/launchProfiles); notYet: listed with `note` (Resources, Settings, Signing).

note.description: Why a page is not there yet.

property.description: One property of the catalog (host-rpc.md, "Project properties") with its value in the evaluated configuration and where that value comes from.

name.description: The MSBuild property (`AssemblyName`, `DefineConstants`), or for the build events the property a legacy project uses (`PreBuildEvent`, `PostBuildEvent`).

page.description: The property page that shows it, as Visual Studio groups them.

section.description: The group on the page (`General`, `Output`, `Events`, `Strong naming`, `Advanced`, `Win32 resources`).

label.description: Visual Studio's label (`Assembly name`, `Treat warnings as errors`).

description.description: Visual Studio's help text, one sentence.

type.description: How the page edits it: string (a text box), bool (a check box writing `trueValue` or `falseValue`), enum (a choice list of `values`), list (a text box of `;`-separated entries, written as one property), path (a text box with Browse...), multiline (a multi-line text box: the build events).

values.description: An enum's choices, in Visual Studio's order.

trueValue.description: What a bool writes when checked (`true`; `enable` for ImplicitUsings).

falseValue.description: What a bool writes when cleared (`false`; `disable` for ImplicitUsings).

perConfiguration.description: True when Visual Studio edits it per configuration and platform: the page shows the Configuration and Platform lists, and a value entered for one configuration goes to that configuration's conditioned property group (the condition rule).

target.description: SDK-style projects only: the build event is written as Visual Studio writes it, an `<Exec>` in this target (`PreBuild`, `BeforeTargets="PreBuildEvent"`; `PostBuild`, `AfterTargets="PostBuildEvent"`), not as the property.

value.description: The evaluated value in the requested configuration, platform and framework; empty when the property is not defined.

raw.description: The unevaluated text of the element that defines it (`$(DefineConstants);TRACE`); absent when the value is the SDK's default.

source.description: project: an unconditioned element of the project file; conditioned: an element of the project file under a condition that holds for this configuration; inherited: a file the project imports that is not the .NET SDK's (Directory.Build.props, Directory.Build.targets, an imported .props): editing it asks to override in the project (`inheritedFrom`); default: not defined by the project or an inherited file (the SDK's default, or nothing).

definedIn.description: The element that defines the value: its file, its 1-based line, and the condition on it or its property group, if any.

condition.description: The condition of the element, else of its property group.

conditioned.description: The defining element (or its group) has a condition.

inherited.description: The value comes from an imported file other than the SDK's (`source` inherited).

inheritedFrom.description: The file the inherited value comes from.

conditions.description: The conditions of every element of the project file itself that defines this property under a configuration condition (any configuration, not only the evaluated one): All Configurations removes them after confirmation.

readOnly.description: The page shows it read-only: Win32 resources off Windows, every property of a legacy (non-SDK) project (out of scope, shown with a note).
